name: W Hoboken
insider_take: Manhattan views without Manhattan prices — W Hoboken delivers big-city glamour on the Hudson's edge, where New Jersey's coolest mile meets iconic skyline drama.
whats_special: Sitting right on the Hoboken waterfront, W Hoboken offers jaw-dropping, unobstructed views of the Manhattan skyline that rival anything you'd find in the city itself. As part of Marriott's Luminous portfolio, guests enjoy W's legendary "Whatever/Whenever" service with a boutique edge. The hotel sits steps from the PATH train, making NYC effortlessly accessible — yet Hoboken's own lively Washington Street dining and bar scene means you may never want to cross the river.
pro_tip: Book a Hudson-facing room for those unforgettable Manhattan skyline sunsets, and don't skip the rooftop — it's one of the best perches in the entire tri-state area. Earn Marriott Bonvoy points through the Luminous program with every stay!
dont_miss: Hoboken is the birthplace of both Frank Sinatra and baseball — a surprisingly rich cultural history packed into one square mile. Stroll the scenic Hudson River Waterfront Walkway, explore the Frank Sinatra Park right at the water's edge, or hop the PATH train for a quick NYC adventure. Back at the hotel, the WET® Deck and W Lounge are perfect spots to soak up that skyline in style.
pros: Spectacular Manhattan skyline views across the Hudson River
Modern luxury accommodations with signature W Hotels design
Prime Hoboken waterfront location with easy NYC access
Vibrant rooftop bar and upscale dining options
cons: Contemporary design may not appeal to traditional luxury seekers
